Ardyn grants all Demons menace, lifelink and haste, then at the beginning of combat can turn a creature card in any graveyard into a 5/5 black Demon token copy. Eight mana is the clear efficiency cost, mitigated by Heartless Summoning, Urza's Incubator, Rakdos, Lord of Riots and Sneak Attack. Rank #6 in the Oct 12 candidate snapshot; current Oracle, color identity and Commander legality checked. Ardyn is not a Demon itself; it supports the Demon board and creates Demon tokens.
